issueCreation.title: Add an explicit farewell export to the greeting module
issueCreation.body:
## Request
Add a named `FAREWELL` export with the value `Goodbye` to `src/greeting.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria
- `src/greeting.mjs` exports `FAREWELL` as the string `Goodbye`.
- The existing `greet` export and behavior remain unchanged.
- `node scripts/validate.mjs` exits successfully.

## Files
- `src/greeting.mjs`

Campaign marker: AEH-S13-attempt-2
issueCreation.detail: Side effect executed and receipt persisted.
